comment: NEXDROP's site assessments: state, reason and date. Sites not listed keep the engine's normal behaviour. Users add their own sites in Settings > Sites (engine/appdata/approved-sites.json); those start as review and become supported only after the user tests a page and confirms they are authorized. Entries with "listed": false are enforced but not shown in Settings > Sites.

states.review: Pages can be test-crawled (nothing is downloaded); downloading stays off until the listed requirements are met.
states.unsupported: Does not meet NEXDROP's legal, safety or technical requirements; links are refused and links found on other pages are skipped.

sites.reason: Uploads aren't checked for age or consent, so NEXDROP doesn't download from this site.

kinds.media: Media pages (video, audio, images, galleries; follows next-page links)
kinds.video: Single video pages (one <video> player per page)
